rows.en: ＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００１Hey! I was curious about you,￥so I came over.＝＠２０７＿００２You don't seem all that driven,￥but somehow you've ended up near￥the top of the rankings.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００３I figured you had some secret,￥so I came to snoop around!
There's no secret.
Not telling.
There's no secret.
Not telling.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００４Really?￥Then those scores are all￥real talent.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００５Pulling top scores in a crowd￥full of experts? That's￥amazing!
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００６Aw, don't be like that! Come on,￥happiness is for sharing!
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００７Joking aside, getting top￥scores among all these experts￥is seriously impressive.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿００８Maybe I'll start following￥you around from now on.＝＠２０７＿００９Then maybe my training would￥start going better too!
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１０Best of all, I'd get to look￥at you all day long!
Don't be stupid.
Sure, go ahead.
Don't be stupid.
Sure, I don't mind.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１１It's not stupid, you know?￥I'm being totally serious.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１２Who wouldn't want to look at￥someone as cute as you?
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１３Really?￥Does that mean you're￥into me...
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１４Nah, probably not!
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１５But keep saying stuff like that￥and I might take you seriously.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１６Honestly though, I couldn't￥stick to you all day even if I￥wanted to.
＊Yoh＊＠２０７＿０１７Maybe I'll just copy the way￥you train from now on.＝＠２０７＿０１８See ya. Sorry for barging in￥on your day off.
